description: Angular component for a filter predicate UI element, managing form state, validation, and data binding for filter predicates in the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: FilterPredicateComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing ControlValueAccessor and Validator for filter predicate input.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form group and sets up value change subscription.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback function to propagate changes.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Method stub for registering touch callback (not implemented).

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls based on input.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the form group, returns validation errors if invalid.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Populates the form with provided predicate data.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates the bound model with current form values if valid.
